tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /gnas yul rtsa khams kyi dbye ba bzhugs so// spyi bo pu lir mi phyed so sen khams/ /spyi gcig dzā lan phra gzugs ba spu gzugs/ /rna g.yas u rgyan rtse ma lpags pa'i dri/ /ltag par arbur g.yon ma sha'i khams/ /rna g.yon go dar thung ngu chu rgyus khams/ /smin dbus ra mer rus sbal rus pa'i khams/ /mig gnyis de bir sgom ma mchin pa'i khams/ /phrag pa ma lar dbang ma snying gi khams/ /mchan khung kā lar skyon ma mig gi khams/ /nu ma o trer mjug ma mkhris pa'i khams/ /lte ba tri shar ma mo glo ba'i khams/ /sna rtse ko sar mtshan mo rgyu ma'i khams/ /kha ni ka mir bsil sbyin snye ma'i khams/ /mgrin par lam+bar tsha ba lto ba'i khams/ /snying kha kañcir gzhol ma dri chen khams/ /'dom bar hi mar rengs ma mtshogs ma'i khams/ /mtshan ma pre tar mdog nag bad kan khams/ /bshang lam gṛ har spyi ma rnag gi khams/ /brla gnyis sau rar rgyu sbyin khrag gi khams/ /byin pa gser gling sbyor bral rngul gyi khams/ /sor mo nā gar sdu gu tshil gyi khams/ /bol gong sin+dhūr grub ma mchin pa'i khams/ /mthe bong mā rur 'tshe ma mchi ma'i khams/ /pus mo ku lur yid bzang snabs kyi khams/ /a bhed+ya/ mi+i phyed/ su k+ṣ+mā ru pa/ phra gzugs ma/ di bya/ rtse ma/ bā mā/ g.yon ma/ an+t+ra bā ma nā/ brtan thung ngu ma/ kūr+ya dze/ rus sbal skyes ma/ bha ba ke sgom ma/ se ka ra/ dbang ma/ do ṣa/ skyon ma/ biṣ+ṭa/ 'jug ma/ mā ta rā/ ma mo/ sarba rī/ mtshan mo rtag sī ta ra/ bsil sbyin ma/ uṣ+mā/ tsha ba ma/ la la nā rkyang ma/ a wa dhu tī/ kun 'dar ma/ ra sa nā/ ra mo/ pra ba ṇa/ gzhol ma/ kṛṣ+ṇa bar+ṇā/ mdog nag sa ma n+yā spyi ma/ he tu da/ rgyu sbyin ma/ pi yo ga sbyor bral ma/ pre ma ṇī/ sdug gu ma/ sid+dhā/ grub ma/

pā tsi kā/ mched ma/ su ma na/ yid bzang ma/ tri bṛt+tā/ sum bskor ma/ kā mi nī/ 'dod ma/ ge ha/ khyim ma/ tsaṇ+ḍi kā gtum mo/ mā ra dā ri kā/ bdud bral ma/ ༄/ denes+d+yam+mahādz+nyānān/ lus la ye shes chen po gnas/ /sarbasaṅkalpabardzitaṃ/ rtog pa thams cad yang dag spangs/ /byasakaṃsar+b+babastūnāṃ/ dngos po kun la khyab pa po/ /dehas+d+yapinadehadzaḥ/ lus gnas lus las ma skyes so// ༈ etebaṃmahādz+nyānaṃ/ 'di nyid ye shes chen po nyid/ /sarbadeh+yebyabās+d+yitaṃ/ thams cad lus la rnam par gnas/ /adwayaṃdāyarūpañca/ gnyis med gnyis kyi rang bzhin can/ /bhābābhāpād+makam+p+rabhu/ dngos dang dngos med bdag nyid gtso/ /s+d+yiratsalaṃbyās+yasaṃtiṣ+the/ brtan dang g.yo ba khyab cing gnas/ /yāmārūpītsabhāti/ sgyu ma'i gzugs brnyan bzhin du'o// ༈ sarbaman+t+rapadā.oṃkārādaswāhān+t+rahūm̐phaṭkarabidar+bhitaḥ sngags thams cad kyi rkang pa dang por oṃ gyi yig dang mthar swāhā dang hūm̐ phaṭa kyi yi ge'i nang du gzhug go /e waṃ// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 sa lo chen po 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams/ gnas yul rtsa khams kyi dbye ba/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
